annotations.text:
Carpe Diem RMS — coastal blue kept from the existing token system (brand-600 #2288B4, Inter Variable, slate neutrals).

Evolved from the Chili POS reference: corner badges, tinted card bodies, status pills, soft elevation, and the bottom live-order strip.

Six status tint/ink values are NEW — globals.css has only the solid colours today.

Order Entry is Epic 4 — not built yet. Shown here so the system is settled before it is coded.

Seat slots, 86'd items and the sent/locked round reflect the real data model.

Owner Dashboard — the only dark screen, read on a phone at night.

The dark layer is NEW. Page #0F172A and ink #F8FAFC / #94A3B8 are existing tokens; surface #1E293B, hairline #263449 and secondary ink #CBD5E1 are additions in the same slate family.

Cash #2288B4 vs Card #D55181 is the one place two colours must be told apart — validated for colour-vision deficiency on this surface. Every other chart is one series, one hue.

Comps are a ledger, not a chart: the reason code and the approver are the point.
